entry: The owner: "let's have Fable rewrite all of our guiding vision documents and rule files. I think you also need to include the Claude.md because the Claude agent will actually use the Claude.md. So either they need to be symlinked or you need to include Claude-specific rules in that file." The owner reviews the rewrite before any planning starts. CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, which holds what every agent needs, and adds what is true of Claude Code alone.
